purpose: validate provenance/completeness of the sealed O2.7A run and add descriptive reliability; MUST NOT rerun inference or change any O2.7A metric/T_AXIS_STAR/status/threshold/null/multiplicity/grid

audits.A: O2.6 native-residual extension provenance (96/96 + manifest fields)
audits.C: zero-base exhaustive over all 96 cells (P0 retention==R_CAL0<=1e-10, sym<=1e-10, idem<=1e-8, range in col(W), rank==r_best)
audits.D: canonical b8 provenance over all subject x ROI x fold x 25 pairs (no held-out, 25/fold, ||b8||=1, perp<=1e-10, s1>0, source deltanat sha)
audits.E: primary six-test family completeness (6 tests, no T8, 48 participant primary cells)
audits.F: POST_SEAL_DESCRIPTIVE repeat reliability (35 balanced 4-vs-4 split-half cos2 per identity/fold; participant-first) -- NO pass threshold
audits.G: descriptive T1->T8 convergence from sealed outputs only (no fit/extrapolation)
audits.H: generalization continuous diagnostic; any binary overfit field marked NON_AUTHORITATIVE_POST_HOC_DIAGNOSTIC

pass_criteria: O2_7A_POSTSEAL_INTEGRITY_AUDIT_PASS iff A 96/96 AND B 96/96 AND C 96/96 AND D provenance/completeness AND E family+cells complete AND no held-out leakage; reliability has NO pass threshold; else O2_7A_POSTSEAL_INTEGRITY_AUDIT_FAIL and STOP before O2.8
on_pass: preserve O2.7A status + append POSTSEAL_INTEGRITY_VERIFIED; authorize O2.8 RESIDUAL-CAPACITY DECOMPOSITION
